sources.entry: Onloc - Track and share your location in real time. Control and lock stolen or lost phones. (Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Onloc Android app that reports your phone's location and battery level to a self-hosted Onloc server so you can track and lock lost or stolen devices.
summary.what_it_does: This repository contains the Android client for Onloc, a service for tracking and locating your devices. The app sends the phone's location and battery level to the Onloc instance you choose. The README describes the app as a sender of this data; it does not list other features in detail. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as able to share location in real time and control or lock stolen or lost phones, but the README itself does not spell out those capabilities. Installation of the server side is covered on Onloc's website and in the separate website repository.
use_cases: track lost or stolen Android phone
share phone location in real time
report battery level of my phone to my own server
how_to_run: Set up an Onloc server instance (installation steps are on Onloc's website and in its website repository)
Point the app at your Onloc instance
notable: Sends location and battery level to a server of your choice
Client for a self-hosted Onloc service
caveats: Requires a separately hosted Onloc server; this repo is only the Android client
README gives no detailed setup steps and points elsewhere for installation
keywords: alternative to google find my device
